scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @zoryqon/api && npm run build -w @zoryqon/worker && npm run build -w @zoryqon/web && npm run build -w @zoryqon/admin && npm run build -w @zoryqon/mobile
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @zoryqon/contracts && npm run build -w @zoryqon/core && npm run build -w @zoryqon/database
scripts.dev:setup: npm run env:init && npm run dev:infra && npm run migrate -w @zoryqon/database
scripts.predev: npm run env:init && npm run build:packages
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web,admin -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @zoryqon/api" "npm run dev -w @zoryqon/worker" "npm run dev -w @zoryqon/web" "npm run dev -w @zoryqon/admin"
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run forbidden-terms:check && npm run db:migrations:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
